background: Former 15-year NBA guard (born May 1970) and All-Defensive stalwart on the early-2000s Kings who moved into Sacramento's broadcast booth and radio before joining Mike Brown's staff as an assistant (2022-24). Named interim head coach when Brown was fired on Dec 27, 2024 and went 27-24 over 51 games, reaching the play-in (loss to Dallas). Signed a multiyear deal as permanent head coach in May 2025. His first full season (2025-26) under new GM Scott Perry collapsed to 22-60 (14th in West) amid injuries, rotation criticism, veteran benchings (Malik Monk, Zach LaVine) and an April 2026 NBA investigation into an intentional foul he ordered while mistakenly believing the Kings had a foul to give (he was cleared of tanking; the league called it a mistake). Retained for 2026-27, the Kings opened 0-6 through Oct 31, 2026 with a bottom-five offense and defense, though rookie Darius Acuff Jr. has emerged. Preaches defense-first, '94 feet' pickup and pace, but his teams have graded out as offense-first and defensively porous.
